title: Topology of black hole thermodynamics: A brief review
summary: Recent explorations of topological aspects in black hole thermodynamics have achieved unprecedented progress. By utilizing topological numbers, different black hole systems can be categorized into distinct universality classes. This universal classification is particularly evident in thermodynamic limits, offering valuable insights for developing a comprehensive quantum gravity framework.
